releaseNotes: v8.14.7: High-Speed Multi-Stream Background Resilience & Title Sanitization: 1) Wall-Clock Elapsed Timer: upgraded translation progress timer to use Date.now() and visibilitychange event listener, eliminating frozen/stalled timer display when switching between apps or returning from background; 2) Chapter Title Sanitizer: automated cleanup of cultural footnote blocks, superscript citations, and translator tags from EPUB headings and table of contents; 3) Live Diagnostics Feed: real-time streaming of telemetry logs directly inside the Translator tab; 4) KeyPool Dispatch Micro-Staggering: randomized jitter and 300ms minimum inter-worker lease spacing to eliminate 40ms burst stampedes on Google Gemini API gateways.
